name: Watase Seiichi
source:
A college student with a bit of a nerdy streak.

Because of his family's business, he is an expert ballroom dancer, but he is not proud of it, in fact, he hates it.  He is unable to let go of this environment that he has obtained, albeit reluctantly.

Surprisingly dexterous with his hands, he makes use of a variety of equipment.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=208701]getchu[/url]]
